newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar slightly weaker on foreign trend.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar slightly weaker on foreign trend.

text.p: The U.S. dollar's strength against the yen overseas pulled the Taiwan dollar down further in early trade on Tuesday but dealers said they expected the local unit to stabilise around current levels.
After 45 minutes, the Taiwan dollar was at T$27.440 against Monday's sharply depreciated close of T$27.420.
Turnover through dealers was US$125 million.

Minor equity funds continued to flow into the rallying stock market, a trend expected to bolster the Taiwan dollar, but the U.S. dollar's strength against most major currencies in Asian trading pulled the local unit down, dealers said.
"Because the U.S. dollar is so strong now, some importers have started to buy U.S. dollars in case the greenback moves even higher," said one dealer.
A T$27.42-45 trading range was seen for the rest of the session.
